the ab initio determination and refinement of a novel CBM36 domain at atomic resolution provides a molecular basis for the unique binding of xylo-oligosaccharide substrates and the potential for future applications in biotechnology.
the ab initio determination of a protein's structure, in the absence of a homologous structure, can be a powerful tool for structure-function analysis.
